node_definition.done_when: An edit_plan write that changes a plan's section_declarations returns the plan's readiness after the write together with its closure_blockers, so a coordinator ticking the last section sees closable and the close op in the same answer. The fields are added where reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py already adds review_owed to the write's result, with a helper beside _review_owed_fields in reckon/mcp_deadlines.py following its shape: on any failure to compute, readiness is null and readiness_error names why, and the write itself still succeeds. Readiness is read from the roadmap's existing readiness ladder and closure_blockers through their current public entry points in reckon/roadmap.py; reckon/roadmap.py is not edited by this node, because another run holds it. No obligation row is added and reckon/crew/obligations.py is unchanged. New tests in tests/test_a_finishing_write_offers_its_close.py pass: a fixture edit_plan write that ticks a plan's last implementable section returns readiness closable with the plan's closure_blockers; a write that leaves an implementable section returns readiness ready, which is the control; a write that changes no section declaration carries no readiness field. The gate log shows the first test failing on the base commit, where the write returns no readiness. Gate, run in place on the fleet allocation with its log under the run directory: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_a_finishing_write_offers_its_close.py tests/test_an_edit_tells_its_author_a_review_is_owed.py tests/test_edit_plan_sets_a_section_field.py tests/test_finished_plan_reads_closable.py tests/test_gates_on_finished_work_release.py, judged by failure delta against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the changed paths.
